blind.second_guess: miniature tea set on a tray
blind.description: An ornate oval vanity tray made of polished gold holding several miniature vintage perfume bottles and cosmetic jars: a pink ribbed bottle with a decorative stopper, a slender gold perfume bottle with an atomizer bulb, a small white/cream jar with a gold cap, and a dark teal bottle with a red bulb. The geometry is solid, smooth, and well-detailed with metallic and glossy ceramic/glass materials.
blind.from_above: An oval gold platter/tray containing four small circular bottle tops and stoppers in pink, gold, cream, and teal with red accents.
blind.height_vs_figure: Extremely small compared to the 5 ft 9 in figure, measuring around 4 to 6 inches high and under a foot wide (reaching only to lower ankle height).
